findings.title: Not met: No purchase tags tied to Shopify thank-you / checkout URLs — GTM-5S6NX9
findings.detail: 1 active tag(s) fire on checkout / thank-you URLs or events: Custom HTML #13. This container loads on the storefront, and with Checkout Extensibility it no longer runs on checkout or thank-you pages, so these tags most likely never fire. Why it matters: Missing purchase conversions starve bidding algorithms and understate ROAS.
findings.recommendation: Move purchase conversions to Shopify Customer Events (app pixel or a custom pixel subscribing to checkout_completed), then confirm Google Ads / Meta purchase conversions are recording.

findings.title: Not met: GA4 — One implementation per property
findings.detail: G-8T9FVLXPLP <- Shopify app: Google & YouTube x34, Shopify custom pixel #50724935 x8, GTM GTM-5S6NX9 x1 Why it matters: Two implementations double-count events and revenue.
findings.recommendation: Keep one implementation per property - on Shopify usually the Google & YouTube app, unless GTM carries a richer setup (then switch GA4 off in the app).

findings.title: Universal Analytics still deployed
findings.detail: 2 active UA tag(s) in GTM. UA stopped processing data in July 2024.
findings.recommendation: Delete UA tags, GA Settings variables and UA-only triggers.

findings.title: Needs attention: Google Ads — Single deployment route
findings.detail: Hits come from 3 routes: GTM GTM-5S6NX9 x41; Shopify custom pixel #17858631 x20; Shopify app: Google & YouTube x14; Theme HTML (hard-coded) x6. Why it matters: Parallel routes double-count, drift apart, and make consent handling inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: On Shopify, keep the native app integration (server-side events, consent API, maintained by the platform) and remove the GTM / theme / custom-pixel copy unless it adds something the app can't.

findings.title: Needs attention: Microsoft Ads — Single deployment route
findings.detail: Hits come from 2 routes: Shopify custom pixel #19890247 x9; Theme inline script x8. Why it matters: Parallel routes double-count, drift apart, and make consent handling inconsistent.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to one deployment route per platform.

findings.title: No consent banner shown to this (US) visitor
findings.detail: 5 ad platform(s) fire without a banner — normal for US opt-out. A US opt-out link (Do Not Sell / Your Privacy Choices) is present.
findings.recommendation: Confirm EU/UK visitors get an opt-in banner and that the US opt-out link + GPC actually suppress ad pixels (Shopify Customer Privacy sale_of_data).

findings.title: Needs attention: Measurement ID in a variable, not hard-coded — GTM-5S6NX9
findings.detail: 11 of 11 GA4 event tags hard-code the measurement ID. Why it matters: Hard-coded IDs make property migrations and staging setups error-prone.
findings.recommendation: Reference a Constant / Lookup Table variable so the ID changes in one place.

findings.title: Needs attention: Custom event names don't shadow GA4 standard events — GTM-5S6NX9
findings.detail: Custom GA4 events named like standard ecommerce events: lp001_add_to_cart, lp002_add_to_cart, lp003_add_to_cart, lp004_add_to_cart. Why it matters: Non-standard names fragment reporting and aren't used by GA4 ecommerce or Ads bidding.
findings.recommendation: Use the standard event name with a parameter (e.g. add_to_cart + placement=lp001) so it lands in GA4 ecommerce reports and Ads key events.

findings.title: Needs attention: No unused variables — GTM-5S6NX9
findings.detail: 9 variable(s) not referenced by any tag, trigger or variable: GA Settings (UA) #16, DLV - gtm.elementClasses, DLV - gtm.elementTarget, DLV - gtm.elementUrl, Auto-Event - TEXT, DLV - gtm.scrollUnits, DLV - gtm.scrollDirection, DLV - gtm.visibleRatio Why it matters: Clutter hides what actually drives data.

findings.title: Needs attention: GA4 — Single GA4 property
findings.detail: 2 GA4 propertys receive data: G-3F0KB1R8FY, G-8T9FVLXPLP. Why it matters: Extra IDs split audiences and send customer data to accounts nobody watches.
findings.recommendation: Confirm each is owned and in use; retire leftovers from agencies or old accounts.

findings.recommendation: Confirm each is owned and in use; retire leftovers from agencies or old accounts.
